headline: Recommended approval of signs for Graze Craze, Idore Aesthetics & Wellness, and YMCA, and approved July 9, 2026 minutes
summary: The board reviewed three sign applications: Graze Craze at 103 Cabot St., Idore Aesthetics & Wellness at 146 Cabot St., and YMCA at 7 Reservoir Road, recommending approval of all three. The board also approved the July 9, 2026 meeting minutes as amended and voted to add a future agenda topic on temporary signage and banners.
decisions: Recommended approval of the signs for Graze Craze at 103 Cabot St., subject to the plans submitted, 6-0.
Recommended approval of the wall sign for Idore Aesthetics & Wellness at 146 Cabot St., as presented, 6-0.
Recommended approval of the wall sign and freestanding sign for YMCA at 7 Reservoir Road, subject to the plans submitted, 6-0.
Approved the July 9, 2026 meeting minutes, as amended, 6-0.
Added a future agenda topic to discuss temporary signage and temporary banners, 6-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to recommend approval of the signs for Graze Craze at 103 Cabot St., subject to the plans submitted, specifically the updated plan delivered at the meeting. Scott seconds. Motion carries (6-0).
Motion to recommend approval of the wall sign for Idore Aesthetics & Wellness at 146 Cabot St., as presented. Barone Jr. seconds. Motion carries (6-0).
Motion to recommend approval of wall sign and freestanding sign for YMCA at 7 Reservoir Road, subject to the plans submitted. Ouellette seconds. Motion carries (6-0).
Motion to approve the July 9, 2026, meeting minutes, as amended. Hutchings seconds. Motion carried (6-0).
Motion to include a future agenda topic to discuss temporary signage and temporary banners. Ouellette seconds. Motion carries (6-0).
